title: Deactivating one part in bulk uses the singular lines while the title stays Deactivate parts?
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2 are active. Nothing is confirmed in this case, so no part changes.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory, Active tab > the actions menu (button_inventory_actions) > Deactivate parts.
  2. Tick QAPL-T1 only, then click Deactivate on the bulk bar.
  3. Read the three lines under the lead.
  4. Click Cancel (button_cancel_part_status_change).
  5. Also tick QAPL-T2 and click Deactivate.
  6. Click Cancel, then the bulk bar's X.
custom_expected:
1. Bulk mode starts: the checkbox column shows, the bar reads "0 selected" and Deactivate is disabled.
  2. The confirmation (dialog_part_status_change) opens titled "Deactivate parts?" (the bulk title stays plural) with text_status_change_lead "1 part selected."
  3. In this order: "This part won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders." (regular), "Existing records that use it stay as they are." (medium weight), "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." (grey). No "These parts ..." or "... use them ..." wording.
  4. The confirmation closes, nothing changes, and QAPL-T1 stays ticked ("1 selected").
  5. "Deactivate parts?" with "2 parts selected." and the plural lines "These parts won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders." and "Existing records that use them stay as they are."
  6. Nothing changed: bulk mode ends and both parts are still on the Active tab.
